reasoning: «думаю еще можно сделать дату» names a possibility the person is not asking for now: a feature has just shipped and nothing related is being built, so this is an idea, not an instruction. The trailing «потому что в те же каналы будет много раз по времени» is the idea's own grounds — it restates why the idea wants what it wants and carries no separate judgment worth keeping after the idea closes — so it is not a second act. The idea is worth raising but still amorphous (what a date is attached to, and what it would change, is unstated), so it gets one live question in the person's own terms — build it now or park it, and what exactly the date should do — and becomes a row only on his own word. Nothing is filed in a second list. A turn that accepted no work names no dimension and calls no specialist, and produces no new piece of work.
